requirements.description: The shop displays the full product catalogue to signed-in users.
Customers add products to the cart and the checkout counter reflects the cart size.
The cart lists selected products, calculates totals and allows removal.
Customers choose a delivery country, accept terms and complete a purchase.

testCases.title: Shop lists the complete product catalogue
preconditions: User is signed in through the login page

steps.action: Read the product titles on the shop page

testCases.expectedResult: The shop shows iphone X, Samsung Note 8, Nokia Edge and Blackberry in that order.

testCases.title: Adding products increments the checkout counter
preconditions: User is signed in and the cart is empty

steps.action: Click Add on iphone X and Blackberry

testCases.title: Cart contains exactly the products that were added
preconditions: User is signed in and the cart is empty

steps.action: Add Samsung Note 8 and Nokia Edge

testCases.expectedResult: Cart rows list Samsung Note 8 and Nokia Edge only.

testCases.title: Cart grand total equals the sum of line totals
preconditions: User is signed in and the cart is empty

steps.action: Add three products and open the cart

testCases.expectedResult: The grand total equals the sum of all line totals.

testCases.title: Removing a product deletes its row from the cart
preconditions: User is signed in and the cart is empty

steps.action: Add iphone X and Blackberry and open the cart

testCases.expectedResult: Only Blackberry remains in the cart.

testCases.title: Customer completes an order end to end
preconditions: User is signed in and the cart is empty

steps.action: Add iphone X and open the cart
Click Checkout and type 'ind' in the delivery location
Accept the terms and click Purchase

testCases.expectedResult: Success alert 'Success! Thank you! Your order will be delivered in next few weeks :-).' is shown.

testCases.title: Delivery country suggestions match the partial text entered
preconditions: User is on the checkout page with a product in the cart

steps.action: Type 'ind' in the delivery location field

testCases.expectedResult: Suggestions list exactly India and Indonesia.

testCases.title: Continue Shopping returns to the catalogue and keeps the cart
preconditions: User is signed in and the cart is empty

steps.action: Add Nokia Edge and open the cart

testCases.notes: Observed: the counter resets to ( 0 ). Automated as an expected failure until the defect is fixed.

testCases.title: Purchase is blocked when the delivery country is empty
preconditions: User is on the checkout page with a product in the cart

steps.action: Accept the terms and click Purchase

testCases.expectedResult: Purchase is prevented and a validation message asks for a delivery country.
testCases.notes: Acceptance criteria for checkout validation are not documented. Confirm the expected behaviour before automating.
